title: Sources say Anthropic struggles to speak President Trump's language; a Trump administration official says it "screwed us" after failing to "honor" a cyber EO (Axios)
summary: Axios: Sources say Anthropic struggles to speak President Trump's language; a Trump administration official says it “screwed us” after failing to “honor” a cyber EO — Anthropic has once again found itself in the Trump administration's crosshairs over an inability to communicate effectively, sources tell Axios.
contentText:
Axios :

Sources say Anthropic struggles to speak President Trump's language; a Trump administration official says it “screwed us” after failing to “honor” a cyber EO   —  Anthropic has once again found itself in the Trump administration's crosshairs over an inability to communicate effectively, sources tell Axios.
